oracle_realizations.information_to_error: A good rank-k projection allows Bob to recover the signs in the queried rows; solving Index requires Ω(m(d−m)) bits.
oracle_realizations.query_and_feedback: Read each row sequentially, without rereading; this is not an unrestricted matvec oracle.
oracle_realizations.sampling_and_reuse: Independent random signs; Bob selects random distinct indices.
